title: Snapshot Growth
statement: Implement `solve(before, after)`. Both are dicts of line id to allocation count. Return the sorted list of line ids whose count grew. Lines that shrank or stayed equal are omitted. Lines only in `after` count as growth.
hints: Keep a key when after's count is greater than before's, treating absence as 0.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A tracemalloc diff names the lines that allocated more between two snapshots.

editorial: A tracemalloc diff names the lines that allocated more between two snapshots. Growth is the leak candidate. A line that stayed flat is not. Sorting the report makes the test stable and the ticket readable.
